Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the time this morning — great discussion and appreciate the transparency on data flows. Quick recap and a few asks from our security/procurement team so we can move the PoC/contract forward: 

- Can Hearthwell provide a copy of your SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) or confirm if you have a Type II in-process?
- If a full Type II is not available, would you be able to provide an interim attestation (commonly called a bridge attestation) that covers the date range our procurement team asks about?
- Would you grant our security team portal access (or upload docs) to your trust/trust-portal so we can pull evidence? If a portal invite is easier, please let us know the security contact to invite.
- Attached is a short vendor security questionnaire (redwood_vendor_dsq.xlsx). If you can complete and return, we’ll route to our security engineers for a quick pass.

Next steps I suggest: you send the report/attestation or portal invite to lauren.bishop@redwood.com (cc’d), and we’ll confirm once we have everything. If it’s easier, we can schedule 20 minutes for an intake with your security lead.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this squared away so we can finalize pricing and timeline.

Best,
